Print an entry's value

Usage:
  gage show [OPTIONS] <query>

Arguments:
  <query>  

Options:
  -c, --clip          copy to the clipboard instead of printing, and clear it after a timeout
      --field <NAME>  print one entry from fields instead of the value
  -q, --qr            render a QR code instead of printing the value
  -u, --use <NAME>    vault to operate on (default: the current vault)
  -h, --help          Print help
